name: Anvil Shoulder
description: Lower the shoulder and hit the target with the dense weight of a forged frame.

name: Forged Hide
description: Draw qi into the skin and flesh together so a blunt blow lands on something dense and springy.

name: Counterweight Step
description: Swing the free arm against the stepping leg to keep the trunk steady through a quick turn.

name: Ligament Wake
description: Stretch and warm the ligaments with qi so the limbs move freely and with more power.

name: Dense Rebuke
description: Shove a heavy blow off its line with the forearm and answer with the shoulder.

name: Bone Chime
description: Strike a bone against bone and hear the ring to judge how sound the frame is in yourself or an ally.

name: Dropweight Crush
description: Settle every pound of the body behind one downward blow that drives through the guard rather than round it.

name: Forged Mantle
description: Hold a thick coat of qi over hide and flesh through a long exchange so each blow loses force before it lands.

name: Heavy Elbow
description: Hammer the point of the elbow down on the target's collarbone with the whole back behind it.

name: Heel Hammer
description: Raise the knee and stamp the heel down onto the target's foot or shin.

name: Ballast Stance
description: Sink the weight so low and wide that a push finds no purchase on you.

name: Crouch Spring
description: Compress low on both legs and release upward and forward into the target's space.

name: Muscle Flush
description: Send fresh blood through aching muscle of yourself or an ally to clear the burn of effort.

name: Leaning Mass
description: Lean the whole body into a shove that grinds the target's guard down toward the floor.

name: Rebar Spine
description: Stiffen the spine with qi so it carries heavy blows downward through the legs to the ground.

name: Knee Drop
description: Drop to one knee under the target's reach and hook its leg so it falls onto its back.

name: Mass Cleave
description: Raise the whole body onto the toes and fall with it through a downward blow that splits guards.

name: Pounding Chain
description: Hammer four heavy blows in the rhythm of a smith so each falls on the dent the last one made.

name: Restoring Breath
description: Take slow deep breaths that carry qi to wounded flesh and lift the worn body of yourself or an ally.

name: Weary Guard
description: Hold the arms high and close even when the shoulders burn from long effort.

name: Obstinate Jab
description: Throw a plain short blow that does not lose force however tired the arm.

name: Plodding Gait
description: Keep a steady low pace that burns no breath and leaves the legs fresh for the end.

name: Burn Flush
description: Drive qi through the legs and arms to wash out the spent humours that slow and cramp them.

name: Dull the Ache
description: Press numbing qi into a hurt joint of yourself or an ally so it can bear weight again.

name: Pulse Reset
description: Slam a flat hand to your own chest and restart a flagging heartbeat with a sharp pulse of qi.

name: Blood Cleansing
description: Pass qi through the whole circuit of the blood to strip poison or taint from yourself or an ally.

name: Unwearied Frame
description: Spread qi evenly through every muscle so the body keeps full strength through a long fight.

name: Aura Skin
description: Hold a thin film of qi just outside the skin that softens the first touch of a blow.

name: Reaching Fist
description: Throw a fist with qi leading it so the blow lands a hand's width past the knuckles.

name: Aura Pace
description: Carry the qi field forward a step ahead of the body and follow it in a smooth stride.

name: Body Mapping
description: Spread the qi field over a person and feel every bone and muscle for strain or break.

name: Surge Skin
description: Flood skin and muscle with qi at once to push through a single burst of effort.

name: Qi Check
description: Meet an incoming blow with the edge of the qi field and push it off its line.

name: Flesh Bloom
description: Let the qi field settle over a wound of yourself or an ally and draw new flesh across the gap.

name: Outer Hammer
description: Swing the arm and let the qi field hit a breath before the hand so the target is struck twice.

name: Shed Impact
description: Snap the qi field outward at the instant of contact to throw off a share of the blow.

name: Qi Slam
description: Gather the qi field into the shoulder and drive it into a target so the force bursts out around it.

name: Living Armor
description: Let the qi field thicken into a layer that moves with the body and blunts every blow upon it.

name: Paired Fists
description: Throw both fists together at the target's chest so the guard cannot cover both.

name: Pairing Guard
description: Raise both arms in the same arc so the guard covers the head and the chest alike.

name: Twin Lunge
description: Lunge forward with both arms reaching so the step and the strike land together.

name: Pair Rhythm
description: Beat a steady two-count with the arms and let qi follow the count into every blow.

name: Cross Break
description: Cross the arms against the target's guard and tear it open on the pull.

name: Crossed Brace
description: Lock both forearms together and brace to take a heavy strike across the front.

name: Arm Mending
description: Hold both hands round a strained arm of yourself or an ally while qi eases the fibres.

name: Twin Hammer
description: Bring both fists down together onto a single point so the second blow lands on the dent of the first.

name: Paired Reply
description: Turn a blow aside with one arm and let the other follow the same line into the striker.

name: Azure Heel
description: Open the hand and strike with the heel of it with hip and shoulder moving as one.

name: Bright Hide
description: Polish the skin with qi until it shines and turns a cut or a blow.

name: Dual-Track Step
description: Move the feet on two lines at once so the body holds its place while the hands go forward.

name: Skyward Breath
description: Lift the chin and draw a great breath upward so qi rises through the chest to the arms.

name: Hawk Heel
description: Drop from a rise onto the target with the heel leading and the weight falling after it.

name: Wound Glaze
description: Smooth a thin film of qi over a graze or a shallow cut so it stops weeping on yourself or an ally.

name: Paired Sweep
description: Parry with both forearms in a paired sweep that turns even a heavy blow wide.

name: Heated Knuckle
description: Hammer the target's ribs with a heated knuckle that strikes twice in one beat.

name: Measured Stride
description: Take a long measured step that carries you out of a blow and your guard across the gap.

name: Hide Rebound
description: Harden the polished hide to throw a share of a striking force back along its path.

name: Stooping Hawk
description: Leap and fall onto the target with the shoulder and knee together and the hide shining with qi.

name: Azure Carapace
description: Hold the brightened hide as a shell over the whole frame that blunts blows and charges the next strike.

name: Bone Channel
description: Open a line of qi down the long bones so force travels along them without loss.

name: Flow Strike
description: Pass the force of a step up the leg and trunk and out through the fist.

name: Current Guard
description: Let a blow run along the arm and out through the back foot into the ground.

name: Swirl Gait
description: Circle round a force with a curving step and come at the target from the side.

name: Silt Clearing
description: Wash stiffness out of the joints of yourself or an ally with a slow pulse of warm qi.

name: Returning Wave
description: Catch the force of a strike in the bones and send it back through the striker's own arm.

name: Marrow Flow
description: Wash the marrow with qi to clear taint or poison that has settled in the bones of yourself or an ally.

name: Spillover Palm
description: Strike so hard that the force overflows the target and bruises those standing near it.

name: Bone Tide
description: Gather the force of a great blow in the long bones and send it back at the striker in full.

name: Surging Bones
description: Let a surge of qi run down every bone in turn so each blow in a series lands harder than the last.

name: Windward Lean
description: Lean the body into the wind with the knees bent and hold your place against its push.

name: Gust Shoulder
description: Drive forward with the wind at your back and hit the target with the full line of the shoulder.

name: Long Oath Stride
description: Take a long even stride on the line chosen and hold it without turning aside.

name: Chest-Wide Breath
description: Breathe with the chest open to the wind so qi fills the lungs and spreads through the arms.

name: Pivot Bearing
description: Turn the whole body onto a new bearing and let the blow slide past the shoulder.

name: Wind Rub
description: Rub chilled limbs of yourself or an ally with warmed hands until feeling and strength return.

name: Unyielding Lean
description: Lean into the force of a charge with the whole frame and hold the line until the charge breaks.

name: Oath Shoulder
description: Drive through the target with a sworn shoulder blow that carries on past the point of contact.

name: Bare Frame
description: Stand uncovered with qi held in the frame so blows strike something that will not give.

name: Even Pace
description: Run with long strides on flat open ground and keep the breath even.

name: Open Palm Strike
description: Strike openly with the whole palm and no feint and trust the weight of the body.

name: Weather Reading
description: Feel the air on bare skin and know the push of an approaching strike before it arrives.

name: Sealed Breath
description: Hold a full breath behind sealed lips and send its qi to every muscle at once.

name: Chill Rebuff
description: Throw off cold and numbness by flaring qi to the skin the moment it bites.

name: Oathbound Knit
description: Pledge aloud to hold and let qi knit the wounds of yourself or an ally closed.

name: Storm Brace
description: Brace the frame against a beating of blows and turn each one into steadier footing.

name: Burden Cast
description: Cast off the heaviness of a lingering poison or curse from yourself or an ally with qi and breath.

name: Uncovered Blow
description: Hold qi in the frame for a long breath and loose it in one blow that needs no cover.

name: Whole Endurance
description: Fill the entire body with held qi so it keeps standing under blows that would drop a lesser frame.

name: Bearing Stance
description: Take a firm stance on a chosen bearing and hold it against every push.

name: Narrow Advance
description: Advance along a single line without a step to either side.

name: Ramming Hip
description: Drive the hip into the target at the end of a pressing step.

name: Soles Sense
description: Feel through the soles which way the pressure lies and where the foe is placing its weight.

name: Settled Weight
description: Let the weight settle through the legs until each blow carries the whole of it.

name: Push Turning
description: Turn the foe's push aside against its own weight and spoil its stance.

name: Immobile Frame
description: Hold still under a heavy press with qi packed into every joint.

name: Strain Wring
description: Wring the backlash of a bad cultivation strain out of the meridians of yourself or an ally.

name: Stance Shatter
description: Drive through the foe along the held line and shatter its stance and its guard at once.

name: Locked Press
description: Pin the target against a push of its own and hold it there through every struggle.
